Summary: On request from ASE2000 to SunSpec simulator using SunSpec Modbus TCP protocol, wireshark captures proper values
Preconditions:

Actions:
1. Open SunSpec Modbus Simulator exe containing folder in command prompt and use the command, modKSim.exe -p 8081 to run the application.
2. Open a browser and enter "http://localhost:8081/modbus/login" to view UI of simulator. In login page configure Modbus Server Port as 502 and click Submit.
